none: PAS LON-9ABD81: Roman copper alloy coin: nummus of Constantine I or II
contea di ritrovamento: Greater London (Inghilterra e Galles)

A Roman copper alloy coin: contemporary copy of a nummus of Constantine I or II dating AD330-335. Reverse: GLORIA EXERCITVS, two soldiers standing either side of two standards. Reece period 17. This coin is thinner than official coins. Obverse: Diademed and cuirassed bust right. Obverse inscription: CONSTANTIN[---]. Reverse: Two soldiers standing either side of two standards. Reverse inscription: [GL]O[RIA EXERCITVS]. Die axis measurement: 12.00. Dimensions: diameter: 18.11mm; weight: 1.01g
